metadata.description: Vision-driven mobile QA for Claude Code: drive real devices, emulators and simulators by screenshot, or run Gherkin suites into HTML reports.

plugins.name: argus-device
plugins.description: Let Claude drive Android/iOS devices, emulators and simulators purely by sight: screenshot, look, tap/swipe/type/press. Appium under the hood, no UI tree, no LLM key needed.

plugins.name: argus-runner
plugins.description: Run vision-driven test suites: feed .feature/.md cases, the agent watches the screen, executes, self-judges pass/fail and emits an HTML report with screenshots. Includes /argus-drive, where Claude itself is the brain.
